description: Change the quantity of a cart line (the key comes from cart_view). Quantity 0 removes the line.

key.description: The key of the cart line, from cart_view

qty.description: The new number of units; 0 removes the line

session_id.description: Only if your client does not keep the MCP session (the Mcp-Session-Id header): the session_id that an earlier answer of this server gave you. It keeps the same cart between calls.

name: cart_update
